historical_reviews.v3_1: Runtime topology and firmware inventory answer different questions: `/proc/cpuinfo` exposes per-logical-CPU state, `lscpu` summarizes kernel topology/online state, and DMI describes populated sockets. All three must reconcile to the recipe without assuming equal wording.

original_test_intent: Verify the exact SUT's processor population, identities and usable topology against the recipe by reconciling complete per-logical-CPU, kernel topology and DMI socket evidence, including model, family/stepping, sockets, cores, threads, caches, features, microcode and online/offline state where applicable.
original_method: Authenticate the SUT and SSH host key, pin the CPU/BIOS/OS recipe, collect untruncated `/proc/cpuinfo`, `lscpu` and privileged `dmidecode -t processor` with versions/status, normalize topology and identity fields, explain source-specific representation differences, and preserve logs without changing CPU, governor or BIOS state.
manual_activity: A platform owner approves the CPU recipe and resolves any DMI versus kernel topology, microcode or feature discrepancy before deciding the outcome.
safety_requirements: Do not use sshpass or disable host-key checking
Do not change CPU online state, frequency, governor, SMT, microcode or BIOS
Stop on wrong host, permission or source contradiction
agent_execution_scope: Parse logical processors and socket topology
engineer_actions: Approve privileged DMI collection or alternative
Disposition offline CPUs, disabled SMT or feature differences

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command loses host authenticity, exposes password handling, truncates a per-CPU file and omits the source-required DMI view; its output cannot support `all CPU information`.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through verified-host SSH, capture full `/proc/cpuinfo`, full `lscpu` (and useful parseable form if supported), and complete `dmidecode -t processor`, with exit status and no truncation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three source commands and the 20-minute activity remain; only insecure transport, truncation and generic log clearing are removed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce socket and logical-CPU tables that separately compare DMI population, kernel topology/online state and per-logical-CPU identity/features to the approved recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authenticated transport, complete evidence and explicit source semantics instead of treating one short excerpt as the inventory.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correctly named CPU can still expose the wrong socket count, disabled cores/threads, inconsistent stepping/microcode or missing features.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Virtualization, firmware settings and kernel mitigations can alter visible flags/topology; such differences require recipe-aware disposition, not automatic failure.

project_override_considerations: Define authoritative CPU identity/topology fields, expected online/offline and SMT policy, acceptable DMI/kernel naming differences, microcode requirement and any virtualization or BIOS feature exceptions.
expected_evidence: Complete `/proc/cpuinfo`, `lscpu` and DMI processor outputs with exit status

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require comprehensive CPU inventory against SPEC. DeepSeek's omission/truncation and insecure transport are execution defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: SUT identity, recipe, access and DMI permission are identifiable prerequisites. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if complete processor sources or authoritative field mapping cannot be obtained.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted firmware socket view and makes per-logical-CPU completeness, host authenticity and cross-source reconciliation auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: DMI may list a physically populated processor while the kernel exposes fewer online cores or threads because of BIOS policy, hardware faults or boot parameters. Conversely, identical logical-CPU model strings do not prove socket population. Only reconciliation of these different observation planes can establish the full CPU configuration.
